verdict.rationale: vLLM documents an OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support. A CLI command and an official Docker image start that server, and feature docs describe API-level controls such as `tool_choice` in the chat completion API, structured outputs and reasoning fields. Community users confirm they drive it through the OpenAI-compatible API with existing ChatGPT tooling. Missing for 10: an evidenced full endpoint/authentication reference in the pack.
